shouldFix.why: This is the defect CODEX-V2-S1 raised about claude2v1, repaired for the v1 lane in this very successor and re-created for the v2 lane in the same edit. The pin chain is the mechanism by which a coordinator can see every recorded finding's disposition; a pin that reports an empty advisory roster for a verdict that has one breaks that chain at the newest link.
shouldFix.itIsSubstantivelyFoldedAlready: v2's O-1 asked that only one field claim standing LIVE for COORD. v3 does exactly that - recordedInputs is now NAMED-PROPERTIES-ONLY and I confirmed reMeasurementAtV3 is the sole LIVE claim. So the fix is enumeration and credit, not new work.
shouldFix.severityReasoning: SHOULD-FIX, matching how this corpus grades missing reviewer-lane advisory records (CLAUDE-V5-S1, CLAUDE-V6-S2, CLAUDE-V9-S1 in the sibling family, and CODEX-V2-S1 here).
shouldFix.fix: Set claude2v2.advisories to ['O-1'] and add the same style of observationsNote used on claude2v1, noting that v2's O-2 and O-3 are RESOLVED-NOTED. Then credit v2's O-1 as folded alongside the NAMED-PROPERTIES-ONLY change in honestyRepairsFromV2.

observations.title: COORD advanced one commit mid-review (D-115); judged on merits, not charged
observations.detail: HEAD moved from the dispatch's 7acef4ff to c4f04e1 (D-115: record sarif-projection-contract.v15 as DR-122 successor candidate) while this review was running, taking COORD from 7da75955... to 5fbd89eb.... This dispatch, unlike the v1 and v2 dispatches, does not restate the PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT allowance, so I judged it on merits rather than invoking a rule: the COORD delta is append-only (57 insertions, 0 deletions); file 08 is unchanged and still matches the dispatch pin; file 04 is unchanged; the subject is unmoved at 3783c319... mode 0444; and reMeasurementAtV3 records exactly the HEAD the dispatch itself names as current. A subject cannot be charged for a commit that landed after both it and its dispatch were written. Not charged.

observations.title: reMeasurementAtV3 duplicates reMeasurementAtV2's measured values exactly
observations.detail: Both blocks record COORD 7da75955..., file 08 1cdcf9d4..., file 04 a74b4511... and measuredAtHead 7acef4ff - identical in every measured field. Nothing moved between v2 and v3 authoring, so the new block measures nothing new; it exists to satisfy the standing rule, which then forced demoting V2. The result is a HISTORICAL block whose data is still current sitting beside a LIVE block with the same data. Not false - 'this-generation' refers to the generation, not the data - but a reader may reasonably ask why both exist. Worth considering whether the standing rule should skip adding a block when nothing moved.

observations.title: Two cosmetic slips in the roster and a demoted block's note
observations.detail: (a) reMeasurementAtV2.note begins 'HISTORICAL HISTORICAL-AT-V2' - the word is doubled; reMeasurementAtV1's parallel note reads cleanly as 'HISTORICAL v1 remasurement'. (b) basedOn.method rosters '/honestyRepairsFromV1 (amend pin)', but that block is byte-identical to v2 - I diffed it. Over-declaring a path is harmless because the roster is a permission list and the universal closure sentence only constrains paths it does not name, so this is not a finding; but the '(amend pin)' annotation describes an edit that did not occur and will confuse the next reviewer.

observations.title: Both of my v2 findings are repaired, and the claude2v1 enumeration is more careful than the finding required
observations.detail: CLAUDE-V2-S1: /recordedInputs is now on the closed roster, and I re-ran the full structural diff - zero off-roster changed paths. CLAUDE-V2-S2: the duplicated guidance line is gone; v3 carries 13 entries with no duplicates, having deleted one and appended two, and the roster honestly drops the '(append)' qualifier because this generation deletes as well as appends. Separately, the claude2v1 advisory enumeration is precise: it maps my observations[] to an advisory roster, includes O-1 and O-2 because they are ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING, and excludes O-3 with a stated reason because it is RESOLVED-NOTED. I verified every severity against the frozen file and the mapping is exactly right. That care is what makes the identical omission at claude2v2 stand out.

summary: Both of my v2 findings are properly repaired and I re-verified each structurally rather than accepting the claim: /recordedInputs is rostered and a full top-level diff now shows zero off-roster changed paths, and the duplicated guidance line is gone with the roster honestly dropping its '(append)' qualifier because this generation deletes as well as appends. My v1 O-2 is also folded - recordedInputs is now NAMED-PROPERTIES-ONLY and exactly one field in the artifact claims standing LIVE. The carries, the DR-109 row, the ID-DEP-S5 tokens and every interface refusal all re-measure clean, and no D-096 (A) grant or SATISFIED claim appears anywhere. One defect stops it, and it is the mirror image of a repair made in the same edit. This successor fixed the claude2v1 pin so it enumerates my v1 advisories, adding a careful observationsNote that maps observations[] to an advisory roster and explains why RESOLVED-NOTED entries are excluded - a mapping I checked against the frozen file and found exactly right. It then recorded claude2v2 with advisories [] and no note, even though the frozen Claude v2 verdict it pins carries O-1 at ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING, the same severity class it just enumerated for v1. pinChainRule requires the full advisory roster of every pinned file, and notFoldedThisSuccessor is empty, so that observation now has no disposition anywhere. The underlying issue is already fixed in v3's bytes, so the repair is enumeration and credit only.
